# Solar Ireland (Solar Ireland Group)

> SEAI-registered solar panel installer serving all 32 counties of Ireland. We install solar PV, battery storage, and EV chargers for homes, handle the full SEAI grant application, and offer a free AI-powered electricity bill analysis that reads your actual usage to estimate your savings.

Solar Ireland is a solar installer based in the Republic of Ireland. Panels carry a 25-year manufacturer warranty and a 10-year installation warranty, and a standard residential system is installed in a single day by a RECI-registered team. Domestic solar has 0% VAT in Ireland, and the SEAI Solar PV grant is EUR 1,800 (Republic of Ireland: owner-occupier homes built before 2021, BER C3 or lower). We also handle the ESB Networks grid connection and the post-install BER assessment.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://solarirelandgroup.ie/pricing.md): system prices and the SEAI grant

## Facts
- Coverage: all 32 counties; the SEAI grant applies in the 26 Republic of Ireland counties
- Certifications: SEAI-registered, RECI-registered electricians, wiring to I.S. 10101, ESB Microgeneration Support Scheme
- The AI bill analysis reads the day and night usage split from your electricity bill; it does not read your roof from a photo or satellite
- Export: excess generation is paid for by your electricity supplier under the Clean Export Guarantee
- Contact: sales@solarirelandgroup.ie
